## Preferred Short Description

Nexor / Plattnericus is a fullstack developer from South Tyrol building real-world web apps, interactive browser experiences, selfhosted systems, DevOps workflows and security-focused infrastructure.

## Preferred Long Description

Nexor / Plattnericus works across frontend, backend, infrastructure and deployment. The public project portfolio includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, JavaScript, Docker, Linux and Cloudflare-based workflows. The direction is fullstack engineering with a strong focus on DevOps and a growing cybersecurity skill set.

## Main Expertise

- Fullstack web development
- Next.js and React
- TypeScript and JavaScript
- Three.js and React Three Fiber
- Browser-based product interfaces
- Linux, Docker and deployment workflows
- Cloudflare and routing
- Selfhosting
- Cybersecurity fundamentals
- Secure deployment practices

## Showcased Projects

### POKYH

Live URL: https://pokyh.com
Description: A school-focused platform built around real student workflows: timetable, grades, absences, messages, mobile app, backend, APIs and deployment.
Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, API, Docker, Cloudflare

### Fly Lab

Live URL: https://fly.pokyh.com
Repository: https://github.com/bedchem/fruit-fly-hub
Description: A real fruit-fly connectome running in the browser: a CT-scanned Drosophila whose 60,001 measured neurons (MaleCNS v1.0) drive it to gamble, trade, game and code on its own — one hub of experiments on the same brain.
Technologies: React Three Fiber, Three.js, neural simulation, Vite

### ThreeJS Portfolio

Live URL: https://threejs.plattnericus.dev
Repository: https://github.com/Plattnericus/ThreeJS_Portfolio
Description: An immersive 3D portfolio rendered in the browser: WebGL scenes, camera choreography and real-time lighting built with Three.js.
Technologies: Three.js, WebGL, GLSL, JavaScript

### StreamDeck

Live URL: https://streamdeck.plattnericus.dev/desktop
Repository: https://github.com/Plattnericus/StreamDeck
Description: An interactive web desktop with app-like windows, tools and a polished browser-based experience, inspired by macOS.
Technologies: React, JavaScript, desktop UI, motion

### Magic-Mirror

Live URL: https://magicmirror.plattnericus.dev
Repository: https://github.com/Plattnericus/Magic-Mirror
Description: A wall-mounted smart display running on a Raspberry Pi: time, weather and daily information rendered as a calm always-on interface.
Technologies: JavaScript, Node.js, Raspberry Pi, selfhosting

### Minesweeper

Live URL: https://minesweeper.plattnericus.dev
Repository: https://github.com/Plattnericus/Minesweeper
Description: The classic logic game rebuilt from scratch: clean grid state, flood reveals, flagging and a focused minimal interface.
Technologies: game logic, grid algorithms, UI

### ProjectilePreview-Mod

Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/mod/projectile.preview
Description: A Minecraft mod that renders the predicted flight path of projectiles in real time, directly inside the game world.
Technologies: Java, modding, physics
